title: Epiphone Power Players Sonic Sidekick Amp SSA-15, Black

long_description.title: Bring Your Electric Guitar to Life
long_description.body: The electric guitar is incomplete without an amplifier to bring its voice to life. The Power Players Sonic Sidekick Combo Amp is the perfect partner for your Power Players guitar - or any electric guitar. This versatile 15-watt amplifier delivers BIG SOUNDS in a small, affordable package. It includes 8 modeled digital amp tones, including Clean, Classic OD, Metal, and Crunch, for a wide variety of tonal options. It also has four Modulation effects, plus Delay and Reverb, for an even more polished and refined sound. A built-in 36-pattern Electronic Rhythm Module with adjustable tempo and volume provides accompaniment for practice sessions, or you can use the Aux Input to connect your phone or other external audio devices to play along with your favorite songs or backing tracks. There’s even a Headphone Output so you can enjoy playing at any time without disturbing others.
